from ashishpandeyone.cdk_lambda_web_function import WebFunctionEndpointOptions
import aws_cdk.aws_lambda as lambda_
from ashishpandeyone.cdk_lambda_web_function import WebFunction, WebFunctionAuthType, WebFunctionEndpointType


fn = WebFunction(self, "Api",
    runtime=lambda_.Runtime.NODEJS_24_X,
    code=lambda_.Code.from_asset("dist"),
    auth_type=WebFunctionAuthType.AWS_IAM,
    endpoint=WebFunctionEndpointOptions(
        endpoint_type=WebFunctionEndpointType.MULTI_REGION,
        regions=["us-east-1", "eu-west-1"]
    )
)

CfnOutput(self, "Url", value=fn.endpoint.url)

from ashishpandeyone.cdk_lambda_web_function import WebFunctionEndpointOptions
per_region = WebFunction(self, "Api",
    runtime=lambda_.Runtime.NODEJS_24_X,
    code=lambda_.Code.from_asset("dist"),
    auth_type=WebFunctionAuthType.AWS_IAM,
    endpoint=WebFunctionEndpointOptions(
        endpoint_type=WebFunctionEndpointType.PER_REGION,
        regions=["us-east-1", "eu-west-1"]
    )
)

CfnOutput(self, "UsEast1Url", value=per_region.endpoint.regional_url("us-east-1"))

api = WebFunction(self, "Api",
    runtime=lambda_.Runtime.NODEJS_24_X,
    code=lambda_.Code.from_asset("build"),
    auth_type=WebFunctionAuthType.AWS_IAM,
    entrypoint="server.js",  # default index.js
    web_function_name="orders-api",  # default: generated from the construct path
    description="Orders HTTP API",
    environment={"TABLE_NAME": table.table_name},
    timeout=Duration.seconds(60),  # per request: 3 seconds to 15 minutes, default 30 seconds
    max_concurrency_per_environment=32
)

api.add_environment("FEATURE_FLAG", "on")
table.grant_read_write_data(api)

java.source:
WebFunction api = WebFunction.Builder.create(this, "Api")
        .runtime(Runtime.NODEJS_24_X)
        .code(Code.fromAsset("build"))
        .authType(WebFunctionAuthType.AWS_IAM)
        .entrypoint("server.js") // default index.js
        .webFunctionName("orders-api") // default: generated from the construct path
        .description("Orders HTTP API")
        .environment(Map.of("TABLE_NAME", table.getTableName()))
        .timeout(Duration.seconds(60)) // per request: 3 seconds to 15 minutes, default 30 seconds
        .maxConcurrencyPerEnvironment(32)
        .build();

api.addEnvironment("FEATURE_FLAG", "on");
table.grantReadWriteData(api);
